findings: Reviewed the first and middle nonflagged response in every entity-partition/task group.
Sample responses contained invented names, book/prize associations, unrelated answers, and refusals.
Several sampled responses visibly end mid-sentence; the run used a 32-token generation cap.
Original predictions do not record per-example generated token counts or EOS/cap termination, so the exact truncation rate cannot be recovered from this JSONL alone.
Some correct facts could be expressed in formats missed by the strict matcher; only a sample was manually reviewed.
The two flagged years remain separately reviewed; no candidate examples were regenerated or excluded.
manual_nonmatch_sample_review.before_m1_comparisons: Define answer-format/extraction rules and a sufficient output cap, record termination metadata, and apply the same protocol at each checkpoint. Preserve this original baseline if a revised audit is run.
